title: DEADLINE: New Venture Challenge Registration Closes on Feb. 8! - University of Colorado Boulder
description:
About the New Venture Challenge (NVC)
The New Venture Challenge (NVC) – a signature program of the University of Colorado Boulder's Innovation & Entrepreneurship Initiative — is a launchpad for aspiring problem-solvers and creatives. During this multi-round, multi-event entrepreneurial competition, teams can win a share of $320,000 and pitch to a live audience at the Boulder Theater. Learn More

 

Who can participate?

Everyone at CU Boulder is invited to participate – current students, faculty, staff or recent graduates. NVC participants can earn a microcredential while gaining experience in creating a startup venture.

 

How Does it Work?

Participants can compete in one of two NVC categories:

Deep Tech Category – for ventures built around a scientific or technological innovation that has been developed using fundamental scientific disciplinesOpen Category – for ventures not meeting the Deep Tech criteria 

Specialty Competition Opportunities

Additionally, NVC offers two specialty competition opportunities:

Social Impact New Venture Challenge – for ventures that want to create a positive social impactWomen Founders Competition – for teams with at least one core team member who is a woman

Registration closes on Feb. 8 for the Social Impact New Venture Challenge (SINVC) competition!

 

About the Social Impact New Venture Challenge (NVC)
SINVC is an offshoot of CU Boulder’s New Venture Challenge, specifically for ventures that want to create a positive social impact. The New Venture Challenge (NVC) – a signature program of the University of Colorado Boulder's Innovation & Entrepreneurship Initiative — is a launchpad for aspiring problem-solvers and creatives. Compete in SINVC for funding to kickstart your venture; the culmination of SINVC is the final pitch competition, where teams pitch for funding—with $5,000 at stake and the top two teams gaining automatic acceptance into the July SEA Change Social Enterprise Accelerator Cohort!

 

Who can participate?

Everyone at CU Boulder is invited to participate – current students, faculty, staff or recent graduates. NVC participants can earn a microcredential while gaining experience in creating a startup venture.
